svg.aria-label: フォークランド諸島の東西の主島と周辺の島々、首府スタンリーとHero・8景の実座標
svg.title: FALKLAND ISLANDS — Coastline and Scenes
svg.desc: GSHHG v2.3.7: 56 separate coastline rings. True WGS84 point anchors (including Stanley capital at 51.69382 S, 57.85701 W; GeoNames ID 3426691), fitted local-equirectangular projection matching Region page overlay. Numbered callouts may be offset; no geographic coordinates are moved.
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS high-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 countries ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit FLK (Falkland Islands); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760.
